script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: ambition

Begin screenplay.

---

Title: The Underdogs

INT. MCKINLEY HIGH SCHOOL - GYM - DAY

A disheveled GYM TEACHER, MR. LEE, watches the students play a lackluster volleyball game. Sweat drips from his brow. His eyes land on a GROUP OF SIX TEENS, huddled together on the sidelines. These are the underdogs.

MR. LEE (calling out)
Boys! Enough gossiping! Come join the game!

The underdogs shuffle onto the court. They struggle, but their determination and camaraderie are evident.

---

INT. MR. LEE'S OFFICE - NIGHT

The underdogs meet with MR. LEE. They discuss their love for volleyball and their dream to compete in the city championships.

MR. LEE (serious)
Boys, I believe in you. But we're missing something crucial... a coach.

---

EXT. MCKINLEY HIGH SCHOOL PARKING LOT - DAY

MR. LEE and the underdogs approach a JAGUAR XJ SPORTS CAR, owned by a former pro volleyball player, JASON MILLER, now a successful businessman. They ask him to be their coach.

JASON (smiling)
I might be able to help. But it'll take commitment. Long hours. Sacrifices.

---

INT. MR. LEE'S OFFICE - WEEKS LATER

The underdogs are seen practicing day and night. They struggle, but they push each other harder. They've never given up.

---

INT. MCKINLEY HIGH SCHOOL GYM - NIGHT

The city championship game begins. The underdogs face their strongest rivals, the favored TIGERS.

The match is intense, with both teams giving it their all.

---

INT. MCKINLEY HIGH SCHOOL GYM - LATER

The score is tied. The tension is palpable. The underdogs execute a perfect play, securing the final point.

CHEERS erupt from the crowd. The underdogs have done it.

---

EXT. MCKINLEY HIGH SCHOOL GYM - NIGHT

The team, now champions, gathers around MR. LEE and JASON, celebrating their victory.

MR. LEE (smiling)
Boys, you've done it. You've shown that determination and hard work can overcome any obstacle.

JASON (proud)
You're the future of volleyball.

---

FADE OUT.

END OF SCREENPLAY.
